# The command client (C2.6): how a command line splits at ";", and the exit codes.
run has-session
run attach-session
run new-session -d -s a 'exec sleep 100'
run attach-session -t a
run attach-session -t nope
run attach -d
run detach-client
run detach-client -t /dev/nope
run detach-client -s nope
run detach-client -a
run new-session -s b 'exec sleep 100'
run has-session -t b
run has-session ;
run ; has-session
run 'has-session;' 'has-session\;'
run has-session -t a\; has-session -t nope
run has-session -t a ; has-session -t nope
run has-session -t nope ; has-session -t a
run kill-server
